Please find our deliverables attached and summarized below. Let me know if you want a row-by-row walk-through; happy to schedule 30 minutes tomorrow.

Attachments included:
- redwood_subprocessors_20260218.csv (canonical roster: vendor, purpose, data types, region, contract link)
- SOC2_report_redwood_2024.pdf (redacted Type II)

Executive summary (high level):
- Primary cloud: CloudGrove (GCP-based; primary processing in us-west2).
- Telemetry/observability: SignalPulse (agent-based capture of anonymized metrics and application logs). We do not capture raw customer PII in SignalPulse; exceptions are high-fidelity traces where pseudonymization is applied and access is limited to on-call engineers. Retention: 90 days for metrics, 365 days for resolved incident traces (pseudonymized). See attached PDF for the dataflow and controls.
- Support/CRM: InteractHelp (Zendesk-based instance managed under our PSA; tickets kept for 2 years; attachments treated as potential PII — redaction guidance included in the CSV notes).
- CDN/cache & backups: EdgeCache (managed partner for static assets) and GlacierKeep (backup archive) listed in roster along with contact/contract links.

Where to find full evidence: secure Drive folder (shared with your security alias): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink. If you need temporary auditor access to full SOC 2 artifacts, we can provide an access-controlled package under an NDA.

If you need additional vendor attestations (SOC 2 from a subprocessor) we can triage the request by vendor and provide either the vendor's attestation or our contract confirmation of responsibility.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether a short sync would help (I have 30–60 min slots available Thu 2/19 10–11am or 3–4pm PT).
